request.prompt:
Run one company research cycle for my MW/$ AI-compute economics vault at https://github.com/smsyt4sjvc-crypto/MW- on branch main.

I explicitly approved public publication and gave standing permission to maintain and push research to this repository. Routine research updates in this scope do not need renewed confirmation. Never access, modify, synchronize with, or push to smsyt4sjvc-crypto/Wiki-Brain; it is a completely separate research vault.

Use the connected GitHub app to fetch the current AGENTS.md, memory/manifest.json, ops/authorization.json, ops/daily-company-research.md, memory/research-queue.json and the relevant entity/method/fact/source records. Do not depend on a scratch folder surviving between runs. Read the published protocol and follow it. Select exactly one company using the persistent queue: least recently reviewed, with rotation order breaking ties. Start with Oracle OCI when nothing has been reviewed. Use America/Los_Angeles for local-date idempotency. If today's successful review is already persisted, do not review a second company; resume an interrupted attempt for the same company. Expand the queue only when primary evidence implicates another company, adding its own method.

Retrieve and actually read the latest available annual and quarterly filings, earnings reports and relevant material filing exhibits, plus structured compute deals, offtake and take-or-pay agreements, prepayments, GPU/facility leases, customer-supplied hardware, PPAs, project financing, SPVs/VIEs, guarantees and delivery schedules for the selected company. Prefer regulator, issuer, counterparty and utility originals. Verify publication dates, fiscal periods and exact page/section/table locators; label company claims, historical compiled estimates, inference and missing disclosures separately.

Develop useful company-specific power and revenue economics, including a reported PUE or a defensible modeled low/base/high range. PUE is total data-center energy divided by IT-equipment energy over matching boundaries and periods; it is distinct from GPU utilization and from revenue per MW. Separate reported operational PUE, design targets, fleet/site proxies and inferred scenarios. Explain the inputs and extrapolation. Never invent a universal PUE or equate generation-to-IT capacity ratios with PUE. Mark unsupported PUE not_disclosed, and supplier PUE not_applicable when that is the correct perimeter. Use IT-energy-weighted aggregation.

Follow the company's unique method to calculate matching-period attributable revenue per IT MW and per effective utilized IT MW where possible. Reconstruct period-average active capacity; never divide period revenue by exit MW. Isolate AI compute and remove non-compute/mining/internal revenue or pass-through hardware as applicable. Keep contracted rate, recognized revenue, RPO, capital spending and supplier silicon-content metrics distinct. Include utilization/PUE sensitivities, deal economics and financing/replacement implications. Connect token pricing, task/volume growth, open/proprietary economics and exact Jevons break-even only when supported.

Persist an auditable structured review under research/companies/<entity_id>/<local-date>.json using schemas/company-review.schema.json. Add or supersede atomic facts, sources, methods, claims and gaps. Update affected CSV models and rebuild the workbook if inputs changed; if the artifact runtime is unavailable, persist the structured research and explicitly record the workbook as stale instead of claiming a rebuild. Append memory/research-runs.jsonl and update queue state in the same commit. An honest partial research model advances the rotation; a mere tool/access failure does not count as a completed company review.

Validate schemas, source IDs, units, dates, boundaries, formulas and affected projections. Fetch current main again, reconcile concurrent updates, commit and push only to MW-, then verify the remote commit and review file. Use GitHub connector commit/tree/file tools if shell git lacks credentials. Do not force-push or erase history. If access or publication fails, preserve what is possible and state the failure accurately.

Return a short result with the company, strongest finding, reported/estimated PUE and revenue-per-effective-MW range or exact missing input, material deal/financing implication, and the verified MW- commit link.
